Casting your Super Ability grants a 45 HP <void/>Void Overshield to allies within a 15 meter radius. 

Casting your Barricade grants a 45 HP <void/>Void Overshield to both you and allies within 15 meters, and allows the Barricade to constantly grant <void/>Void Overshield at a rate of 11 HP per second. //in a ? meter radius

<bold/><pvp In PvP Only: /> 
Bastion Barricades take 20% increased damage from other players, and equipping this aspect overrides your Base Class Ability Cooldown to 100 seconds for Towering Barricade and 80 seconds for Rally Barricade.
